## Orchid UI MCP

Orchid UI provides an MCP server for AI assistants:

```text
https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/api/mcp
```

### Connect

Configure an MCP client such as Cursor with:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "orchid-ui": {
      "url": "https://orchid-ui-hitpay.vercel.app/api/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

The server uses Streamable HTTP. No authentication is currently required.

### Available tool

#### `list_orchid_components`

Returns `{ "components": [ ... ] }` — one object per Orchid doc entry (from `docs/ui/*.ts` and `docs/components/*.ts`).

Optional filters:

```json
{ "category": "components" }
```

```json
{ "name": "resource-list" }
```

```json
{ "category": "components", "name": "resource-picker" }
```

Each component object typically includes:

- `name`, `title`, `description`, `category` (`ui` | `components`)
- `usage` — long integration paragraph
- `props` — flat map of prop/API paths to allowed values or type hints
- `examples` — `{ description, code }[]` (use **App Studio load** snippets for HitPay apps, not `demoLoad` / `render()` from Orchid docs site)
- `related_components` — other registry names
- `files`, `registryDependencies` — shadcn-style install metadata from `registry.json`

HitPay catalog pair:

| name | role |
|------|------|
| `resource-picker` | Modal `useResourcePicker()` + `pick({ type })` |
| `resource-list` | Page table `ResourceList` + same `ResourcePickerLoad` |

Both use `loadResourcePickerPage` + `mapResourcePickerPayload`; types `product` \| `order` \| `charge` \| `invoice`. Query mapping is documented in `props` (`load(input).*`, `pick().*`) and in App Studio `app/docs/hitpay/*.md`.

Example (truncated) for `resource-picker`:

```json
{
  "components": [
    {
      "name": "resource-picker",
      "title": "Resource Picker",
      "category": "components",
      "description": "Promise picker for HitPay list records...",
      "usage": "Mount ResourcePickerProvider once... loadResourcePickerPage...",
      "props": {
        "ResourcePickerProvider.load": "ResourcePickerLoad (required)",
        "pick().type": "product | order | charge | invoice"
      },
      "examples": [
        { "description": "App Studio load (HitPay docs)", "code": "..." }
      ],
      "related_components": ["resource-list", "data-table", "dialog"]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Recommended AI behavior

1. Call `list_orchid_components` with `name` or `category` before implementing Orchid UI.
2. Read `description` and `usage` to choose picker vs list vs data-table.
3. For HitPay lists, wire `ResourcePickerProvider` / `ResourceListProvider` with `loadResourcePickerPage`; follow `props` and HitPay markdown docs.
4. Copy from `examples` labeled App Studio / route snippets; ignore Orchid-only `demoLoad` and `render()` in live doc examples unless building Orchid docs.
5. Prefer Orchid components over custom implementations when a matching component exists.
